metadata.description: Hard and soft skill map for each SW Engineer role/level, cross-referencing job_descriptions.json (responsibilities, expertise specifics, knowledge requirements), performance_expectations.json (Efficiency, Quality, Engagement, Responsibility-Taking, Cooperation) and bosch_potential_indicators.md (Learning Ambition, Emotional Power, Interpersonal Impact, Intellectual Capacity).

methodology.hardSkills: Derived from each role's 'expertiseSpecifics' and general 'responsibilities' in job_descriptions.json, plus its 'knowledge' requirements. Depth/scope scales with level (L1 guided execution -> L2 independent ownership -> L3 strategy/architecture/mentoring).
methodology.softSkills: One statement per performance dimension (Efficiency, Quality, Engagement, Responsibility-Taking, Cooperation), summarizing the associateExpectation for that role/level in performance_expectations.json.
methodology.boschPotentialIndicators: 3-4 of the 12 Bosch potential indicators most evidenced by the role's impact/communication/innovation level and performance expectations, grouped under their parent category (Learning Ambition, Emotional Power, Interpersonal Impact, Intellectual Capacity).
